{"id":1411997780,"question_id":724,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 9 months","timestamp":1728077345,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"17 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1411997780/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Find Pivot Index","memory":"35.8 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int pivotIndex(vector<int>& nums) {\n        vector<int>lsum(nums.size(),0);\n        vector<int>rsum(nums.size(),0);\n        for( int i=1;i<nums.size();i++){\n            lsum[i]=lsum[i-1]+nums[i-1];\n        }\n        for( int i=nums.size()-2;i>=0;i--){\n            rsum[i]=rsum[i+1]+nums[i+1];\n        }\n        for( int i=0;i<nums.size();i++){\n            if(lsum[i]==rsum[i]){\n                return i;\n            }\n        }\n        \n         return -1;\n    }\n    \n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"find-pivot-index","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":32}
